IBPS RRB XV 15th Scale-I, II, III Online Form 2026 (13706 Posts) – Extend – Full Details

Institute Of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released a notification for the recruitment of IBPS RRB Bank Officer Scale-I, II, III Post on the official website of the IBPS. This recruitment has been issued for 13706 posts. Online applying process for IBPS RRB XV 15th Scale-I, II, III Recruitment 2026 has Started from 01 September 2026 & candidate can apply till 27 September 2026. Candidates must check complete details for IBPS RRB XV 15th Officer Scale-I, II, III Recruitment 2026 which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 September 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 27 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 September 2026
  • PET Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Pre Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
